purpose: Bounded finite version of the M6 Pass C requested measured tests (Intuition vs Long-Term Plans and vs Scheming Symmetry; Galvanic Iteration vs Borne Upon a Wind) plus incumbent-challenge measurements; exact, no sampling, no simulator claims
not_run_and_why: A full multiplayer game simulation of hostile opponent play, earliest attack turn under interaction and Breach-pile success rates was not run: no validated simulator exists in this repository, and an unvalidated one would manufacture precision. The bounded version measures stager/enabler access exactly, enumerates every hostile Intuition choice for the three relevant piles, and classifies every Galvanic Iteration copy target in the 99 by rules.
script: exact hypergeometric (python math.comb) over the actual 99 of the approved list
method: exact hypergeometric / exhaustive enumeration over the actual 99 (no sampling); n = cards seen (7 opening + draws)

cards.Long-Term Plans: third from top (captured by any X>=3; Jeleva's minimum normal cast is X=4)
cards.Scroll Rack: any number from hand on top

T1_rules: Jeleva's ETB exiles the top X of each library, X = mana spent to cast her (CR 107.3/601.2f; commander tax increases X). A card put third from the top by Long-Term Plans is captured immediately by any X>=3, so the GrokBot advisory premise that Long-Term Plans 'waits two draws' is false for the Jeleva line. Intuition puts one card into hand and two into the graveyard; it never places a card in the library, so it is not a Jeleva stager and its cards are never 'exiled with Jeleva' (CR 607.2a linked abilities).

opponent_choice_outcomes.Underworld Breach to hand: Combo live only if graveyard holds >=6 other cards to pay two escape exiles of three (LED {0}+3, Brain Freeze {1}{U}+3); Intuition itself is one. Live later in the game, not on turns 1-3.
opponent_choice_outcomes.Lion's Eye Diamond to hand: Underworld Breach is in the graveyard; nothing in the 99 casts an enchantment from the graveyard except Yawgmoth's Will (play cards from graveyard this turn) or Mnemonic Betrayal (opponents' graveyards only, so no). Line dead without Yawgmoth's Will.
opponent_choice_outcomes.Brain Freeze to hand: Same as above: Breach stranded. Line dead without Yawgmoth's Will.
opponent_choice_outcomes.hostile_result: Opponent gives LED or Brain Freeze; pile fails in 2 of 3 choices and the hostile opponent always picks one of them.

opponent_choice_outcomes.Thassa's Oracle to hand: Both enablers in graveyard; no flashback/recursion in the 99 for instants except Yawgmoth's Will or Underworld Breach. Dead otherwise.
opponent_choice_outcomes.Demonic Consultation or Tainted Pact to: Oracle in graveyard; no reanimation in the 99. Dead.
opponent_choice_outcomes.hostile_result: Fails under any hostile choice unless Yawgmoth's Will/Breach is already available.

opponent_choice_outcomes.any: Hand gets one stager; the hostile choice is Personal Tutor (sorcery-only, sorcery speed). Net: 3 mana + 1 more mana to stage, against Long-Term Plans' 3 mana at instant speed straight to position 3, or Scheming Symmetry's 1 mana straight to top.
opponent_choice_outcomes.hostile_result: Always yields a stager, but strictly slower than either incumbent it would replace.

T2_conclusion: Under hostile opponent choice Intuition never beats Long-Term Plans or Scheming Symmetry at the Jeleva top-stage job; its best pile is a slower stager. Breach and Oracle piles are dead under hostile choice in the early turns. Scheming Symmetry's cost is acknowledged: its two target players must be different players (CR 115.3), so one other player (normally an opponent) also tutors a card to the top of their library.

copy_outcomes.Brain Freeze: +3 cards milled per player targeted (copy not counted for storm)
copy_outcomes.Final Fortune: no added value: each copy creates its own extra turn with its own lose trigger at that turn's end step, so you lose at the end of the first extra turn
copy_outcomes.Gamble: second tutor plus a second random discard
copy_outcomes.Mind's Desire: extra Desire resolution (copy not cast, so it adds no storm trigger; CR 707.10, 702.40a)
copy_outcomes.Pact of Negation: second counter (no upkeep for the copy)
copy_outcomes.Peer into the Abyss: harmful if self-targeted (draw half the remainder, lose half life again) unless retargeted to an opponent
copy_outcomes.Rite of Flame: +RR (copy is not a Rite cast in a graveyard count)
copy_outcomes.Vampiric Tutor: second tutor to top (only one card stays on top)

T3_Galvanic_vs_Borne.rules: Galvanic Iteration copies the next instant or sorcery you cast this turn; a copy is not cast (CR 707.10), so it adds no storm count and no prowess/Harmonic Prodigy trigger; flashback {1}{U}{R} gives a second use. Borne Upon a Wind lets every spell you cast this turn have flash and draws a card: it lets Jeleva herself be cast at an opponent's end step so she has been under control since the start of your turn and attacks without a haste source (CR 302.6), and lets sorcery-speed Doomsday/Ad Nauseam/Wheel/Peer/Mind's Desire be cast in response or off-turn.

T5_Spellseeker_reach.note: Spellseeker's ETB is a Wizard trigger, so Harmonic Prodigy doubles it (two tutors) only when Prodigy is already on the battlefield; it costs {2}{U} against Mental Misstep's free {U/P}.

T6_land_colour_sources.note: Gemstone Caverns counted as any colour only with a luck counter (not starting player and in opening hand); Exotic Orchard is opponent-dependent and produces nothing on turn 1 on the play.
